channel.title: Aaditya Tamrakar · Blog
channel.description: Writing on algorithmic trading tools, machine learning, web development and open source SDKs by Aaditya Tamrakar.

item.title: Building an NSE option chain analyser in Node.js
item.description: How I built a Node.js app that pulls the live NSE Nifty option chain, classifies every strike by price and OI change, and renders sentiment on one page.

item.title: How to read open interest: long buildup, short covering and friends
item.description: A practical guide to reading open interest with price change: long buildup, short buildup, short covering and long liquidation, and what each implies.

item.title: Charting the cash vs futures spread for NSE stocks
item.description: Building a small Node and Express tool that computes and charts the daily spread between the cash price and the futures price of NSE stocks.

item.title: What I built and maintain for the open source trading community
item.description: The broker SDKs and bots I forked, adapted and use in my own tooling: Kite Connect in Go, XTS and 5paisa in Node, Hummingbot in Python, option pricing.

item.title: Solving captchas with scikit-learn: a 99.7% pipeline
item.description: A captcha solving pipeline in Python: trim, split letters, rotate, resize to pixels and classify with a scikit-learn model, served through a PHP API.

item.title: A fantasy cricket team optimiser is a constraint solver
item.description: Treating fantasy cricket team selection as a constraint problem: top 18 players by pick rate, enumerate every valid 11, then pick by points from JSON data.

item.title: How to build an offline-first notes app with a service worker
item.description: Step by step: an installable, offline-first notes app using localStorage for data, a service worker for caching and a web manifest for Android install.

item.title: How to broadcast live video to a room with Socket.io
item.description: How a panic alarm system streams live browser video to everyone in a Socket.io room: capturing frames, naming rooms and fanning out events in Node.js.

item.title: Shipping a food delivery product solo: Laravel, Ionic and lessons
item.description: What it took to ship a food delivery product alone: a Laravel and MySQL backend with admin and SMS, a Bootstrap 3 web frontend and an Ionic mobile app.

item.title: Reporting engines for small businesses: cron, email and AdminLTE
item.description: Lessons from building Laravel reporting engines for a car dealership and other small businesses: cron schedulers, emailed reports and AdminLTE dashboards.

item.title: Designing an options trading UI for beginners (CS615 project)
item.description: Designing an options trading interface for beginners as a CS615 UI design project at UMass Boston: goals, prototype on GitHub Pages and what I learned.

item.title: Ten years of public code: what changed from 2016 to 2026
item.description: A look back at ten years of public repositories, from a CSS video player in 2016 to trading SDKs in 2026, and how my tools and habits changed along the way.
